rv.q: I cannot say enough about this group of actors directed by Trent Stork - bravo Trent!
And I also know that Hand to God , in this crazy, bloody, and absolutely wonderful production, is something you just have to see.
"Hand to God" is a deeply funny, foul-mouthed play about grief and the necessity of devils. The performances are excellent and skillful, but the production is presented in a fairly safe package.
Six years ago I said that this play is a MUST SEE! Let me repeat myself- "this production is a Must See and worth the trip to Aurora! This is an amazing story about people and their lives.
What you can be absolutely assured of is that it's a brilliant piece of theatre and well worth watching.
